changelog:
- Added a references/cookbooks.md file listing available Cargo CDK cookbooks and examples.
- Expanded the SKILL.md description and triggers to mention cookbook support and provide a menu location.
- Updated documentation to direct users to references/cookbooks.md for starting from a cookbook solution.
- Removed the deprecated skill-card.md file.
- Minor documentation improvements and clarifications throughout.
summary: Manage a whole Cargo workspace as code — declare connectors, models, plays, tools, agents, MCP servers, segments, context, folders, files, workers, and apps in TypeScript, then reconcile them with `cargo-ai cdk` (init → types → plan → deploy), the way you would run Pulumi or the AWS CDK. Triggers: "as code", "in git", "version-controlled", "reproducible", "Terraform for Cargo", "set up a whole workspace", "staging and production", "deploy from CI", "review this in a PR", "cargo.state.json", "scaffold from a template", "is there a cookbook for this", "start from a cookbook". Skills with a CDK example (TAM building, account scoring, contact sourcing, routing, AI SDR, rep cockpit) live in gtm-skills; menu in references/cookbooks.md. Skip when: it is a one-off operation, a read, or an ad-hoc query — use the matching capability skill.
